## GENERATED_MARKER

```ts
const GENERATED_MARKER
```

Text every generated tool file (README and completions) carries in its first lines. `tbx gen`
treats a file under `tools/` as its own, and so may delete it, only when it has this marker.

## GeneratedFile

```ts
interface GeneratedFile
```

A generated file: `path` is relative to the repo root, `content` ends with a newline.

## compareText

```ts
function compareText(a: string, b: string): number
```

Orders two strings by UTF-16 code unit, so every runtime and ICU version sorts generated
output the same way.
